profile_mutation_recovery.settings_reset_body: Saved settings don't match the current contract, so the dashboard can't open. Data is preserved; a full local reset runs only after your confirmation below.
profile_mutation_recovery.request_failed: The recovery request couldn't finish. Check the diagnostic code below.
profile_mutation_recovery.auth_failed: The settings protection PIN is required or incorrect. Check your PIN and try again.
profile_mutation_recovery.handoff_failed: Your profile change is saved, but the restart request failed. Retry only that request below.
profile_mutation_recovery.title: Local profile recovery required
profile_mutation_recovery.resetting_body: A profile mutation is still fenced. Wait for it to finish, or explicitly rebuild the local profile if the operation was interrupted.
profile_mutation_recovery.committed_body: The durable profile commit is complete while runtime owners are still reopening. Wait briefly, or rebuild the local profile if this state persists after a worker restart.
profile_mutation_recovery.failed_body: The previous profile mutation failed and normal runtime owners remain closed. Rebuild the local profile before continuing.
profile_mutation_recovery.complete_body: Your profile change is saved. Entropy needs to restart before you can continue.
profile_mutation_recovery.contract_reset_body: This build detected an older development-profile baseline. Normal runtime owners remain closed until you explicitly rebuild the local profile.
profile_mutation_recovery.confirm_body: This permanently removes local settings, history, progression, and Zen model data, then creates one new profile generation.

security_vault.preparing_description: Preparing local data on this device so you can start without a passphrase.
security_vault.preparing_failed: Could not prepare local data. Check the diagnostic code below and try again.
security_vault.incompatible_title: This development profile needs a fresh start
security_vault.description: Your data passphrase protects detailed logs and their encryption key. Site settings, aggregate statistics and protection keys remain readable in the browser profile. This passphrase is separate from the settings protection PIN.
security_vault.paused: Site protection and aggregate statistics continue. New detailed logs are not saved while locked, and unlocking does not reconstruct that missing history.
security_vault.passphrase_help: Use at least 16 characters, up to 128 UTF-8 bytes. A long, unique phrase is recommended. Spaces and Unicode are supported.
security_vault.no_recovery: Keep this passphrase safe. It cannot be recovered. An independently encrypted backup can restore your data.
security_vault.operation_failed: Could not unlock your data. Check the data passphrase and try again.
security_vault.incompatible_description: This pre-release profile uses an unsupported data format. It will not be converted or erased automatically.
security_vault.reset_title: Forgotten passphrase or old development profile
security_vault.reset_description: Starting again erases all local settings, history and keys. Enter your settings protection PIN if one is configured.
security_vault.reset_confirmation: I understand that all local data will be erased.
security_vault.reset: Erase local data and start again
security_vault.reset_failed: Could not reset this profile. Check the diagnostic code below.
security_vault.reset_auth_failed: The settings protection PIN is required or incorrect. Check your PIN and try again.
security_vault.reset_committed: Local data has been reset. The app needs to restart before you can continue.
security_vault.reset_handoff_failed: Local data has been reset, but the restart request could not start. Retry the restart below.
security_vault.popup_locked: This profile uses the previous data lock structure. Confirm your current passphrase in the dashboard so site protection can start without it next time.
security_vault.settings_description: Site protection starts without a passphrase. You can set a separate data lock for detailed logs.
security_vault.lock_disabled_description: Start the app directly. The key that opens encrypted logs is stored in this browser profile.
security_vault.lock_enabled_description: Detailed logs lock after restarting the browser or reloading the extension. Site protection and aggregate statistics continue. New detailed logs are saved after you unlock.
security_vault.remove_lock_description: Confirm your current passphrase to use detailed logs without one. Your existing data and settings protection PIN stay in place.
security_vault.lock_operation_failed: Could not change data lock. Check your passphrase and the diagnostic code below.
security_vault.backup_description: The entire backup, including private keys, is encrypted with a separate backup passphrase. Keep that passphrase safely.
security_vault.restore_local_description: Start without a new data passphrase after restoration. You can enable data lock later in Settings.
security_vault.replace_confirmation: Replace all local settings and history with this backup. The settings protection PIN comes from the backup.
security_vault.restore_handoff_failed: Backup restoration is complete, but the restart request could not start. Retry only the restart below.
security_vault.backup_failed: The operation failed. Check the backup passphrase, settings protection PIN and backup file.
security_vault.changed_unlock_required: Your data passphrase was changed, but the unlocked session could not be saved. Unlock with your new passphrase.
security_vault.removal_unlock_required: Data lock could not be removed. Unlock with your current data passphrase.
security_vault.logs_locked_description: Site protection and aggregate statistics continue. Unlock to open existing detailed logs or save new ones. Detailed logs from the locked period are not reconstructed.
security_vault.separate_description: This profile also locks the keys used for site protection. Confirm your current passphrase to lock only detailed logs, preserving your data and passphrase. Site protection will then start without a passphrase.
security_vault.separate_failed: Could not complete the update. Check the diagnostic code below and try again.
security_vault.reset_return_description: After the reset, the app restarts into the first garden. Browser site-access permissions remain.
